close_reason: Covered by landed strict-handoff commits through fz-hwn.20.8.9: transport now projects upstream callable-flow/surface facts; forbidden recovery helpers are absent; transport_contract_test and cargo check pass.
description: Make transport consume upstream callable-flow facts for callable demand and surfaces. Remove transport's RuntimeDemand::Value + callable type -> escaped upgrade, local callsite-arg surface recovery, and callable-type surface fallback for compiler-owned local callables. Transport may still render explicit opaque external callable contracts from upstream opaque facts, but it must not infer local direct or first-class surfaces from type. Tests must fail if callable_transport_demand or callable_surface_evidence can create a local CallableId fact not present upstream.
title: Transport authority: delete transport demand and surface recovery
